verdict.rationale: Semgrep's core rule engine explicitly supports writing custom detection rules (docs-4,5,21) that can encode organization-specific patterns like internal token/secret formats, and this is validated by a security consultant's real-world use for spotting codebase-specific antipatterns (comm-1). Semgrep Secrets is a dedicated product for credential/API-key detection (docs-8,9,10,32), and custom rules can be layered to extend detection to proprietary formats via Semgrep Code/Editor tooling (docs-5,7). Missing for 10: a dedicated worked example or docs section specifically on writing custom secret-format regex rules (vs. general custom rule guidance), and independent verification of accuracy for internal token formats.
